- Ejecutar scripts:

Cada algoritmo se puede ejecutar suelto con su propio script. Sin argumentos, devuelve el clasico usage() y te da el resultado de un ejemplo con los chars habituales de ADN.

 - LCS recursivo:

 ```
 % python3 act1-lcs.py
 Usage: python3 act1-lcs.py <string1> <string2>, or run without arguments to use default strings (aka 'autotest').
 Length of LCS is 4

 % python3 act1-lcs.py generate 10
 Generated subsequence 1: TTCTCTCGTC
 Generated subsequence 2: TTTTTGACTA
 Length of LCS is 6
 ```

 - Hirschberg:

 ```
 % python3 act1-hirschberg.py
 Usage: python3 act1-hirschberg.py <string1> <string2>, or run without arguments to use default strings (aka 'autotest').
 LCS is GTAB with length 4

 % python3 act1-hirschberg.py ABABDB ADCBAABDDB
 LCS is ABABDB with length 6
 % python3 act1-hirschberg.py generate 80
 Generated subsequence 1: CTAACGGGGGAGAGCCGGATGGGATGCAGTTCCGAACCTACGGGTATCGCACTGCGGATTATCTTGGTACCATGCCCACT
 Generated subsequence 2: CGAGAAAGTAACATCCCCTCGTTTTTCCCGGATCGTATCTATAATGGATTGTAGTAGACGACGCAAACCGTCAAGCAGGG
 LCS is CGAGAAAGCATCCCCTCGTTCCCGGATTATCTTGGAATGCCCACT with length 45
 ```

 - LCS PD tabular:

 ```
% python3 act1-pd_tabular.py
Usage: python3 act1-pd_tabular.py <string1> <string2>, or run without arguments to use default strings (aka 'autotest').
LCS is GTAB with length 4
 %
 % python3 act1-pd_tabular.py generate 500
 Generated subsequence 1: 
 Generated subsequence 2: 
 LCS is  with length 323
 ```
